title: K-injective representative of the unit--Leray abutment map
statement: Let $f:Y\to X$ be a scheme morphism, $K,L$ arbitrary complexes of abelian étale sheaves on $X,Y$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], and $v:f^{-1}K\to L$ a chain map [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Let $\rho:K\to I$ and $\sigma:L\to J$ be K-injective resolutions [def-weil-pbc-kinjective-resolutions]. Suppose $j:f^{-1}I\to J$ satisfies $j\circ f^{-1}(\rho)\simeq\sigma\circ v$, and let $w:\Gamma(X,I)\to\Gamma(Y,J)$ have components the sectionwise inverse-image unit followed by $\Gamma(j)$. For every integer $n$, the map $e_\rho^{-1}H^n(w)e_\sigma$, using the canonical resolution comparisons [def-weil-pbc-termwise-hypercohomology-presentation], equals $H^n(R\Gamma_X(\eta_f);\lambda_f;R\Gamma_Y(v))$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. Here $\eta_f$ is the unit of the derived inverse-image/direct-image adjunction and $\lambda_f$ is the canonical Leray isomorphism. This statement involves no filtration or spectral sequence.

proof.text: Adjoint the comparison j to I→f_*J. Exactness of inverse image implies f_* preserves K-injective complexes. The compatibility hj gives the adjoint map over the augmentation in the derived category.

On K-injective representatives the right-derived units are invertible. Expand the derived-adjunction unit factorization and the defining units of the unbounded Leray comparison. Naturality of these units identifies RΓ of the adjoint comparison with the localized degreewise map w. This is the unbounded computation of the same recipe expressed on D+ by lem-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback-derived-unit; the resolution choices here need not themselves be bounded below.

Apply the homology functor and its factorization through Q. The canonical identifications attached to ρ and σ are resolutionEtaleCohomologyIso, so the equality becomes exactly inv(eρ) ≫ H(w) ≫ hom(eσ) equal to H of the unit--Leray--v map. Homotopic comparisons give equal maps by localization.
